outcome: A customer can redeem a discount code at checkout.

acceptance_criteria.text: A known code reduces the total and an unknown one does not.

expected_verification.assertion: WELCOME10 takes 10% off and an unknown code takes nothing

acceptance_criteria.text: A code cannot be redeemed more times than it allows, and an expired code is refused.

expected_verification.assertion: a single-use code applied twice is refused the second time

security_impact: Unbounded discount redemption is direct revenue loss and is trivially shareable once discovered.
